data.content: Reproduced with Quilt knot 9a25. A failed shipment needed ready_for_implementation, but kno rollback moved shipment only to ready_for_shipment; a second rollback was rejected because queue states are intentionally invalid. Source evidence: src/rollback.rs hardcodes action -> preceding queue. loom/work_sdlc/prompts/shipment.md declares merge_conflicts -> ready_for_implementation and suggests update --status, but the compiled loom/work_sdlc/dist/bundle.json body omits the Failure Modes commands. The suggested update path is also incomplete: execute_update in src/write_dispatch/execute/execute_write_ops.rs refreshes the heartbeat but never calls release_bound_lease, while next and rollback do. kno lease terminate only changes the lease knot state; it does not unbind the work knot, and materialize_expired_lease ignores a raw lease_terminated record. Implement a first-class atomic failure-outcome transition rather than documenting a multi-command workaround.
